page.overview:
Who is Bun's parents?

In 99 AG, Bun volunteered for the Earth Kingdom Army unit of General Andal. His parents opposed his decision due to him being underage and lacking martial abilities, but were unable to do anything as they lacked the money necessary to buy him out of his military service contract.

One week later, Bun brought a group of Kyoshi Warriors under Suki to his parents' house, explaining that they needed a place to stay for the night. Bun's parents shared a meal with the visitors, and his mother responded positively to the warriors' praise of the food. Meanwhile, his father urged Bun to eat more as he needed strength for the future. When Bun happily responded that he could not possibly eat due to his excitement about his deployment, Suki asked in confusion whether the young boy was a soldier. His parents remained silent in response, worry creasing their face, as their son boasted that he would surely capture a Fire Nation dagger as a gift to them. When the boy was distracted by Mira, his parents dejectedly told Suki about their worries.

On the next day, Bun's parents worriedly waved goodbye to their son as he marched off to the frontline.

Thanks to the Kyoshi Warriors' intervention, Bun barely survived his first battle, though he was heavily wounded and lost one of his legs. Bun was thus discharged from the military after just one operation. Afterward, his parents personally thanked the Kyoshi Warriors for saving their son. Talking with Suki, Bun's parents explained that they planned to move to Ba Sing Se, believing the capital to be safer than their home village. The father also noted that Pebble Pond Village had become tainted with "too many bad memories" for the family.
